name: Generate Tiling UVs
explanation_long: Creates tiling UVs by applying cube unwrapping also known as box mapping. UVs are not packed into an atlas and are therefore not itended to be used for texture baking. Warning: This overrides existing UV sets and might therefore lead to issues with existing Texture Sets.

exposed_options.name: Tiling UVs Scale
exposed_options.description: Scale factor for the cube UVs (box mapping). Higher values scale up the individual UVs which, depending on the material and texture leads to a higher tiling ratio (density) across the surface.
